'''Neftali''' was an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Socorro system/Legends|Socorro system]]. Its name in [[Olys Corellisi/Legends|Old Corellian]] meant "home" or "safe place," which is what the planet was to some of the unsavory elements that came to the [[Socorro/Legends|Socorro]] [[Star system/Legends|system]]. It was a barren frozen world with a long orbit around its [[Color/Legends|red]] [[Star/Legends|star]].

It had deep underground chambers that were warmed by geothermal forces. Mosses and lichen grew in these furnaces and provided food for the planet's fauna.
